to: every character in the tavern instance (`instance_emit`), for bets, results and refunds. A slots or wheel result and refund also goes to its owner after the owner left the tavern. `info` and the roulette form go only to you

payload.type: TavernInfo | TavernDiceBet | TavernDiceWon | TavernDiceLost | TavernSlots | TavernWheel | TavernRefund | TavernRoulette

variants.name: Info
variants.when: The reply to `tavern` with `event: "info"` and no `request_id`. With `request_id`, the same fields come in `game_response` `data`.

variants.name: Dice bet
variants.when: A character placed a dice bet.

variants.name: Dice won
variants.when: The dice round ended and the bet won. `gold` is the gross win (`bet.win`), not the stake.

variants.name: Dice lost
variants.when: The dice round ended and the bet lost. `gold` is the stake. There is no `net`.

variants.name: Slots
variants.when: The slots timer (`q.slots`) ended. `event` is `"won"` or `"lost"`. Not sent when a disconnect settles the spin.

variants.name: Wheel
variants.when: The wheel timer (`q.wheel`) ended. `event` is `"won"` or `"lost"`. Not sent when a disconnect settles the spin.

variants.name: Refund
variants.when: The shutdown of the server started (`tavern_close`), and the tavern returned an open wager. Wheel: `index`. Slots: `symbols`. Dice: neither, and `gold` is the total of all dice bets of the character.

variants.name: Roulette bet
variants.when: Dev servers only: the reply to a `bet` with `type: "roulette"`. The payload is the bet object itself, with no `event`.

TavernInfo.summary: The house edge and the largest win that the tavern can pay now.

fields.name: edge
fields.description: The house edge in percent: `0.5`, `1`, `1.5` or `2`. It is lower when the server has more gold (`house_edge`, node/server_functions.js:1384-1396).

fields.name: max
fields.description: 40% of the free gold of the server: `parseInt((S.gold - house_debt()) * 0.4)`. A dice bet whose net win is larger fails with `tavern_gold_not_enough`.

fields.name: game
fields.description: The `game` value of the request, unchanged. Absent when the request had none or a falsy one (`if (data.game)`, node/server.js:12870).

TavernDiceBet.summary: A dice bet that a character placed.

fields.name: dir
fields.description: `"down"` wins when the roll is at most `num`. `"up"` wins when the roll is at least `num`.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The target number of the bet.

fields.name: gold
fields.description: The gross win: `parseInt(stake * odds)`. It includes the stake and the house edge.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The target number of the bet.

fields.name: gold
fields.description: The stake that the character lost.

TavernSlots.summary: The result of one slots spin.

fields.name: event
fields.description: `"won"` when the spin drew a prize.

fields.name: stops
fields.description: One stop per reel: an index into `G.games.slots.reels[r]`.

fields.name: symbols
fields.description: The symbol at each stop. All three are the prize on a win.

fields.name: prize
fields.description: The gross prize from `G.games.slots.prizes`. `0` on a loss.

fields.name: payout
fields.description: The gold that the character got: `prize` minus the cut of the house (the edge on the profit). `0` on a loss.

TavernWheel.summary: The result of one spin of the wheel.

fields.name: side
fields.description: The side of the bet, from `G.games.wheel.sides` (`"sun"` or `"moon"`).

fields.name: result
fields.description: The side of the slice that the wheel stopped on.

fields.name: slice
fields.description: The name of that slice (index 0 of the row in `G.games.wheel.slices`), for example `"teal"`.

fields.name: index
fields.description: The index of that slice in `G.games.wheel.slices`.

fields.name: net
fields.description: The profit: `gold` minus the cut of the house on a win, `-gold` on a loss.

fields.name: payout
fields.description: The gold that the character got: `2 * gold - cut` on a win, `0` on a loss.

TavernRefund.summary: A wager that the tavern returned at the start of a shutdown.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The character that got the gold back.

fields.name: gold
fields.description: The gold returned. For dice, the total of all open bets of the character.

fields.name: index
fields.description: Only for the wheel: the slice that the spin had drawn.

fields.name: symbols
fields.description: Only for slots: the symbols that the spin had drawn.

TavernRoulette.summary: A roulette bet object (dev servers only).

fields.name: odds
fields.description: The odds name of the bet, a key of `tavern.roulette.odds`. Default `"black"`.

fields.name: pid
fields.description: The socket id of the character.

senders.what: The `bet` handler, dice: the new bet. Roulette (dev only): the bet object to you.
`tavern_loop`: the dice round ends and each bet settles.
The timer loop of the character: the `wheel` or `slots` timer ends (`tavern_result`).
`tavern_close`: the start of a shutdown returns each open wager.
